title: Audio generation joins the text API
summary:
Audio generation arrived in the text API, while function calling and search got less prone to losing the plot.

Added `openai-audio` with a selectable voice and binary audio responses. Streaming requests default to PCM16, while non-streaming requests default to MP3; callers can also supply audio settings such as voice and format. The docs now cover audio generation and list 19 supported voices.

Chat requests now retain and forward `tools` and `tool_choice`, fixing function calls that lost those parameters on the way through the text API.

Search requests now use the default search tool and `openai-large`, run tool calls sequentially, and preserve options such as response format on follow-up requests. Polly also gets the current date for time-sensitive searches when there is no system message.

daily.title: Audio generation via text API
daily.text: Generate speech with `openai-audio` and choose a voice; `alloy` is the default. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-audio).

daily.title: Streaming audio in PCM16
daily.text: Stream `openai-audio` output as PCM16, or get MP3 from a non-streaming request. You can also supply audio settings such as voice and format. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
